provenance.method: Owner-authorized HTTPS POST; certificate validation enabled; redirects disabled; 20-second timeout; 1 MB response limit
provenance.scope: Read-only discovery of the supplied account and its one visible heater
provenance.redaction: Envelope projected to code, success flag and null result; account ID replaced; deliberately invalid header is literal test input, not a credential
provenance.limitations: Verifies invalid-token rejection only; natural expiry and competing-login invalidation not induced
